name: Rizuhble's Time Bomb Paradox
point_model: claims about ability tiers require model A and model B to agree

items.name: Extra Regen
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented
items.legacy_note: Getting poked out in lane. Sell it once you're out of slots.

sections.label: Early game
sections.desc: Souls 0-10,400 (levels 1-17). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Pulse Grenade T3. 4.8k spikes: spirit 4.8k at Duration Extender, vitality 4.8k at Veil Walker. Ultimate (Paradoxical Swap) is available from Spirit Lifesteal.

items.name: Extra Spirit
items.caption: +10 spirit adds about 3 to Pulse Grenade's pulse damage (0.30x scaling).
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Duration Extender completes 4.8k spirit in 4000 souls (~4.0 min), 4 purchases

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.caption: Imbued on Pulse Grenade: widens its radius (radius increase per pulse).
items.why: on the path to the build's first 4.8k (spirit): Duration Extender completes 4.8k spirit in 3200 souls (~3.2 min), 3 purchases

items.name: Extra Stamina
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Veil Walker, 7200 souls (~7.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Arcane Surge
items.caption: +20 spirit adds about 16 to Pulse Grenade's pulse damage (0.80x scaling). Upgrade of Extra Stamina (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Duration Extender completes 4.8k spirit in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases
items.legacy_note: Dash-jump right before you throw the grenade.

items.name: Duration Extender
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k spirit tier (3,200 to 4,800 invested): bonus 19 to 38 spirit power. Imbued on Pulse Grenade: its duration-scaled parts (duration 3.2s, debuff duration 8s) get +22%.

items.name: Spirit Lifesteal
items.why: vitality investment only; its 4.8k tier completes at Veil Walker, 3200 souls (~3.2 min) later and vitality is not the first spike colour: timing review (delay, or is a lane/stat reason missing?)

items.name: Veil Walker
items.caption: Completes the 4.8k vitality tier (1,600 to 4,800 invested): bonus 12 to 38 vitality bonus.

items.name: Improved Spirit
items.caption: +18 spirit adds about 19.8 to Paradoxical Swap's swap damage (1.10x scaling). Upgrade of Extra Spirit (already owned): costs 800 souls more, not 1,600.
items.why: imminent: Mystic Vulnerability completes 6.4k spirit in 1600 souls (~1.6 min), 1 purchases

sections.label: Midgame
sections.desc: Souls 10,400-28,800 (levels 17-29). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Time Wall T3, Paradoxical Swap T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Pulse Grenade, pulse damage) grows from 123 to 156.

items.name: Mystic Vulnerability
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 5,600 to 7,200 invested: bonus 38 to 45 spirit power.

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.caption: Imbued on Pulse Grenade: takes 18% off its 20s base cooldown. Takes spirit from 7,200 to 8,800 invested: bonus 45 to 52 spirit power.

items.name: Superior Duration
items.caption: +28% to every duration-scaled effect you have: Paradoxical Swap barrier duration (8s), Time Wall duration (9s), Pulse Grenade debuff duration (8s). Upgrade of Duration Extender (already owned): costs 1,600 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Slowing Hex
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 10,400 to 12,000 invested: bonus 52 to 59 spirit power.

items.name: Warp Stone
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 4,800 to 8,000 invested, crossing the 6.4k, 8k tiers: bonus 38 to 46 vitality bonus.

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.caption: +30% range and radius on everything that scales with them: Paradoxical Swap multi swap (7m), Pulse Grenade radius (5.5m), Pulse Grenade radius increase per pulse (1m). Upgrade of Mystic Expansion (already owned): costs 2,400 souls more, not 3,200.

items.name: Echo Shard
items.caption: Imbued on Pulse Grenade: resets its 20s cooldown for a second cast; the shard's own 30s cooldown grows by that ability's cooldown. Takes spirit from 14,400 to 20,800 invested: bonus 59 to 66 spirit power.
items.legacy_note: Throw the second grenade straight after the first so the stacks pile up.

sections.label: Late game
sections.desc: Souls 28,800-56,000 (levels 29-36). Abilities gained (both point models agree): Kinetic Carbine T3. Your biggest single spirit hit (Pulse Grenade, pulse damage) grows from 156 to 221.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 20,800 to 22,400 invested: bonus 66 to 75 spirit power. | With 4 abilities trained their base cooldowns total 153s; 20% off is 30.6s per full rotation.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: upgrade_of)

items.name: Infuser
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 8,000 to 12,800 invested: bonus 46 to 50 vitality bonus.

items.name: Boundless Spirit
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes spirit from 27,200 to 32,000 invested: bonus 75 to 100 spirit power. | +30 spirit adds about 33 to Paradoxical Swap's swap damage (1.10x scaling).

items.name: Vortex Web
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: upgrade_of)

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented

sections.label: Situational counters
sections.legacy_desc: Dying after Veil Walker? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Warp Stone.
sections.desc: Dying after Veil Walker? Buy what is killing you, cheapest first. Not dying? Skip. Sell Warp Stone.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.caption: Passive: 30% chance to deflect a bullet and 50% to block its on-hit effects; it helps against several gun heroes at once where a timed bullet immunity covers only one.
items.legacy_note: Most of their damage is gun.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.caption: Spirit resist 30, plus 15 more below 50% health: buy it when enemy spirit damage is what kills you.
items.legacy_note: Their spirit damage is what keeps killing you.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.caption: Purges non-ultimate debuffs (silence, slow, disarm) and heals 250, but cannot be used while stunned or asleep, so it answers a hex or silence and not a stun already on you.
items.legacy_note: Slows and hexes keep landing on you.

items.name: Counterspell
items.caption: Your next parry blocks an enemy ability's damage and effects (0.8s window, 23s cooldown), so it only answers an ability you can see coming.
items.legacy_note: A big ability you can see coming at you, like Lash's ult or Grey Talon's charged arrow.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.caption: Immune to bullets only, for 5s on a 24s cooldown, at 1.5m/s slower: buy it against one gun carry, not against ability damage.
items.legacy_note: Their gun carry dives you after your grenades are out.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.caption: Cast on yourself or an ally: removes non-stun debuffs and gives a 600 barrier for 6s, 45s cooldown (halved when cast on an ally), so it covers debuffs and burst damage but not a stun.
items.legacy_note: If you bought Dispel Magic, sell it for this. Otherwise sell Arcane Surge.

items.name: Focus Lens
items.why: no hero-, build- or timing-specific reason established from the data layers implemented (only context: sell_swap)

items.name: Cheat Death
items.why: only generic accurate reasons: Takes vitality from 12,800 to 16,000 invested: bonus 50 to 54 vitality bonus.

items.name: Refresher
items.caption: Resets every ability and charge: up to 141s of base cooldown across your kit, 80s of it the ultimate; the item has its own cooldown of 300s. Replaces Vortex Web: sell it when you buy this (all 12 slots are full).

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.caption: Same-slot upgrade of Superior Cooldown for 3,200 more souls: item cooldown reduction 0 to 25; cooldown reduction 20 to 25..
